data.one_liner: Generates Dart constant files for pubspec.yaml assets to avoid manual string paths.
data.what_it_does: Scans assets defined in pubspec.yaml and automatically generates a Dart resource file containing static constants for each asset path. Supports customization via configuration files, include/exclude rules, and preview comments.
use_when: You want to avoid hardcoding asset strings throughout your Flutter app
You prefer auto-generated resource classes (similar to R files in Android)
avoid_when: You prefer manually managing asset paths as strings
You need dynamic runtime asset loading without code generation
strengths: Supports custom include/exclude rules and replacement rules via fgen.yaml
Provides file preview comments in generated code
weaknesses: Requires running a CLI tool or watching changes
Naming conflicts can occur if different directories contain files with identical generated field names
data.setup_notes: Install globally via pub or run from source, then use the fgen command or configure fgen.yaml in the project root.
